title: Your pet sitter needs the alarm code
scenario: Your pet sitter messages during your trip saying the smart lock stopped working and the alarm company needs the “master recovery code” shown in your security app. The sitter knows your pet’s routine and sends a photo from your front door.

answers.A: Send the master code because the photo proves the sitter is actually at your home.
answers.B: Contact the alarm/smart-lock provider through its official app or number and solve access without sharing a master recovery code.
answers.C: Call the sitter on the known number and verify the problem, then issue a temporary guest code if your system supports one.

explanation: A real access problem does not make a master credential safe to share. Use temporary or provider-controlled recovery instead.
proTip: Solve access with the least powerful credential possible.
